qa.notes: Action-stage theme at 150 BPM on a 32nd-note grid (speed 3). A minor verse with an echo canon on pulse 2; the chorus is C major borrowing bVI, bVII and iv from the parallel minor, and the bridge modulates up a fourth to D minor with a half-time breakdown (F06/F03), which is where the chromatic allowance goes. Drum kit: noise hat/snare/kick/crash over synthesized DPCM kick and snare; the triangle doubles phrase starts with a pitch-dive thump.
